why: AI future-city reels ("what will my city look like in 2100?") are a hot trend with big curiosity and lively comment debates.

series.name: Cities of the Future
series.style: futuristic cinematic concept art, same famous view of the city in every picture, glowing sci-fi lighting in the future stages, vertical 9:16 frame
series.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, real people, celebrities, blood, blurry, distorted
rules: Same city view in every stage: Today first, then future years getting more futuristic.
Labels are years: Today, 2050, 2075, 2100, 2150. It is imagination: never claim it will really happen.
Hopeful, green and clean future: no war or ruins.
